name: tube
title: A developable four-bar: a tube whose wall stands out when pressed
orientation: Standing on its end, one piece, no supports: every hinge's axis is up z, so each bends within its layers, and the first layer is the whole ring.

tube.label: The tube: ground, input, coupler and output links in its wall

turn.rule: The input's design turn: the hinge between the input and the coupler stands 1.43 mm out of the tube and the one between the coupler and the output 1.27 mm in, taking 91.6 N·mm at the input, and the hinges see 0.61% strain against PETG's 1.25% (2.05 times the margin)

wall.rule: The wall's thickness: six lines, stiff beside the hinges' webs

height.rule: The tube's length up z: 100 layers. The hinges' stiffness grows with it, their strain for a turn does not

joint_a.rule: The input's hinge on the ground, round the tube from x

joint_b.rule: The hinge from the input to the coupler: the input is the 60 degrees of wall between

joint_c.rule: The hinge from the coupler to the output: the coupler is 80 degrees of wall

joint_d.rule: The output's hinge on the ground: the output is 80 degrees of wall, and the ground the 140 degrees left

flex.rule: Each hinge's web, its length round the wall: a longer web turns further for a strain

web.rule: Each hinge's web thickness: two lines, the thinnest that prints solid
